title: How To Edit The SEO For Social Media Sharing for SEO Templates
text:
## How To Edit The SEO For Social Media Sharing for SEO Templates
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/5000682655

## Steps
Navigate to My Content > SEO Templates .
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12184690927/original/SisLSvTa3UqRkEbhcGDCv8ynm6NkvNoZUQ.jpeg?1788511925 | alt: ]
Locate the relevant template and click Customize or Edit .
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12184690938/original/4kv96QT0kl7Esr0X2nx-GG6UtL15sm3WTQ.jpeg?1788511938 | alt: ]
On the SEO Settings tab, scroll down to the Social Media Sharing section.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12184690959/original/dzFpdiUYqNtVwXBHIDFibbIvB6POrP1W2g.png?1788511968 | alt: ]
Update the fields as needed.
Click Save This Page .

## Social Media Shared Image
A Social Media Shared Image can be set for the template. As with other SEO settings, this is treated as a suggestion, social media platforms and search engines determine at their own discretion whether to use the supplied image.
A generic, default social media image can also be configured; this is covered separately in the " How to Set a Default Social Media Image " article.
